mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ai_human_handoffs (conversation_id, user_id, tenant_id, reason, related_order_id, emotion, status, assigned_agent, note, created_at, updated_at, resolved_at) VALUES (#{conversationId}, #{userId}, #{tenantId}, #{reason}, #{relatedOrderId}, #{emotion}, #{status}, #{assignedAgent}, #{note}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt}, #{resolvedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM ai_human_handoffs WHERE conversation_id = #{conversationId} AND status != 'closed' ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1
